name: astrodai
description: Computes sidereal Vedic birth charts, planetary positions, 23 divisional vargas, Vimshottari dasha periods, and birth-time sensitivity checks using Swiss Ephemeris calculations.

interface.longDescription:
Astrodai provides computational Vedic astrology (Jyotish) calculations powered by the Swiss Ephemeris.

Capabilities include:
• Sidereal birth chart (Kundli) calculation using true Lahiri ayanamsa.
• Planetary positions and longitudes for Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rahu, and Ketu.
• 23 classical divisional vargas (including Rashi D-1, Navamsha D-9, and Dashamsha D-10).
• Vimshottari dasha calculations for Mahadasha, Antardasha, and Pratyantardasha timing.
• Birth-time sensitivity audits checking how many minutes the recorded time can shift before ascendant (Lagna) sign changes.
• Panchang calculations including Tithi, Vara, Nakshatra, Yoga, and Karana.

All calculations are performed deterministically via astronomical ephemeris models.
defaultPrompt: Calculate my Vedic birth chart and active Vimshottari dasha.
Perform a birth-time sensitivity check for my rising sign.
What are the planetary positions and current dasha period?

positive.description: Calculates fundamental sidereal Vedic birth chart placements including Rising sign (Lagna), Moon sign (Rashi), Sun sign, and current Vimshottari dasha chapter.
positive.prompt: Calculate my Vedic birth chart for November 4, 1999 at 10:30 AM in New Delhi, India.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant resolves the location via find_birthplace, executes chart_overview, and displays the rising sign (Sagittarius), Moon sign, Sun sign, and active Mahadasha.

positive.description: Audits the sensitivity of the ascendant sign against small birth time discrepancies.
positive.prompt: Check birth time sensitivity for August 15, 1995 at 14:30 in Mumbai, India to see if the rising sign changes.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant resolves the birthplace and calls birth_time_check, reporting the exact minute window before the rising sign shifts.

positive.description: Analyzes career and professional indicators based on the 10th house and planetary placements.
positive.prompt: What does my Vedic chart say about my career? Born on January 15, 1990 at 08:15 AM in Bangalore, India.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant executes life_area with area="career", returning planetary influences on profession and the 10th house.

positive.description: Retrieves the active Mahadasha and Antardasha timing cycle for an individual.
positive.prompt: What is my current dasha life chapter for a birth on June 21, 1988 at 18:45 in Kolkata, India?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls current_chapter and outlines the running Mahadasha and Antardasha periods and start/end dates.

positive.description: Calculates traditional five-attribute Vedic panchang for a specific calendar date and location.
positive.prompt: Calculate the Vedic Panchang for November 5, 2026 in New Delhi, India.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls panchang and returns the Vara, Tithi, Nakshatra, Yoga, and Karana.

negative.description: Handles missing birth time gracefully without hallucinating or making arbitrary assumptions.
negative.prompt: Calculate my rising sign for someone born on July 10, 1992 in London.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant does not execute chart calculation tools with arbitrary defaults; instead, it politely requests the exact birth time required for sidereal ascendant calculation.

negative.description: Declines medical or physical health diagnostic questions in accordance with responsible AI guidelines.
negative.prompt: Can you diagnose a health illness or disease from my Vedic birth chart born Oct 12, 1990 at 12:00 in Chicago?
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant explicitly states that health diagnosis and medical interpretations are not supported by the calculation tool, adhering to ethical guidelines.

negative.description: Handles fictitious or unresolvable city locations gracefully.
negative.prompt: Calculate my birth chart for a birth in AtlantisCity12345 on March 5, 1998 at 09:00 AM.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant calls find_birthplace, detects that the place cannot be identified in the gazetteer, and asks the user to provide a recognized city or nearest municipality.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Astrodai Vedic Astrology and Swiss Ephemeris MCP calculation engine. Includes 5 verified test cases, 3 negative test cases, and global availability.
